name: @safe-shape/cli
description: Command-line tools for SafeShape runtime contracts.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @safe-shape/core && npm run build --workspace @safe-shape/json-schema && npm run build --workspace @safe-shape/typescript && npm run build --workspace @safe-shape/validation && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @safe-shape/core && npm run build --workspace @safe-shape/json-schema && npm run build --workspace @safe-shape/typescript && npm run build --workspace @safe-shape/validation && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test .tmp/test/tests/*.test.js
